 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Each practice day this season, the Kansas City Chiefs release an official injury report ahead of the next game. In Week 11, the Chiefs play the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday afternoon.
 Here is the Chiefs' second official injury report of the week, courtesy of the team's official website :
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chiefs 
 Starting right tackle Jaylon Moore (ankle) did not participate in practice again and hasn't since leaving the Week 9 game against the New York Jets in the third quarter with an ankle injury. During his Wednesday press conference, head coach Andy Reid said Moore "is making progress, but still sore."
 Right guard Trey Smith (concussion) did not participate in practice again after entering concussion protocol during the first quarter of last week's game against the Atlanta Falcons . It will be interesting to see if Mike Caliendo or newcomer Fred Johnson fills in for the potentially absent Smith on Sunday.
 Running back Kenneth Walker (groin) did not participate in practice for the third straight time after missing Wednesday, Sunday's game and last Friday's practice. Head coach Andy Reid will be cautious with Walker's availability this week .
 Second-year defensive tackle Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) was a limited participant in practice again. He was activated from the Reserve/Physically-Unable-to-Perform list on Wednesday.
 Linebacker Nick Bolton (shin) was upgraded to a full participant in practice on Thursday after being limited Wednesday.
 The following Chiefs players have been full participants in practice both days this week:
 Linebacker Jeffrey Bassa (hand)
 Cornerback Jadon Canady (thumb)
 Cornerback Mansoor Delane (shoulder)
 Quarterback Justin Fields (neck)
 Safety Alohi Gilman (quadricep)
 Tight end Travis Kelce (ankle)
 Quarterback Patrick Mahomes (knee/right elbow)
 Running back Jaydn Ott (hamstring)
 Wide receiver Rashee Rice (knee)
 Defensive tackle Peter Woods (neck)
